vv32:1.1: Latā ca Sajjā Pavarā ca devatā Accimatī rājavarassa sirīmato Sutā ca rañño Vessavaṇassa dhītā rājīmatī dhammaguṇehi sobhatha. || ||
vv32:2.1: Pañc' ettha nāriyo agamaṃsu nhāyituṃ sītodakaṃ uppaliniṃ sivaṃ nadiṃ tā tattha nhāyitvā rametva devatā naccitva gāyitva Sutā Lataṃ bravi: || ||
vv32:3.1: Pucchāmi taṃ uppalamāladhārinī āveḷinī kañcanasannibhattace timīratambakkhi nabheva sobhane dīghāyukī kena kato yaso tava. || ||
vv32:4.1: Kenāsi bhadde patino piyatarā visiṭṭhakalyāṇitar' assu rūpato padakkhiṇā naccagītavādite ācikkha no tvaṃ naranāripucchitā ti. || ||
vv32:5.1: Ahaṃ manussesu manussabhūtā uḷārabhoge kule suṇisā ahosiṃ akkodhanā bhattu vasānuvattinī appamattā uposathe[ahosiṃ]. || ||
vv32:6.1: Manussabhūtā daharā apāpikā pasannacittā patim ābhirādhayiṃ sadevaraṃ sassasuraṃ sadāsakaṃ abhirādhayiṃ tamhi kato yaso mama. || ||
vv32:7.1: Sāhaṃ tena kusalena kammunā catubbhi ṭhānehi visesam ajjhagā āyuñ ca vaṇṇañ ca sukhaṃ balañ ca khiḍḍāratiṃ paccanubhom' anappakaṃ. || ||
vv32:8.1: Sutaṃ nu taṃ bhāsati yaṃ ayaṃ Latā yaṃ no apucchimha akittayī no patino kir' amhākaṃ visiṭṭhanārinaṃ gatī ca tāsaṃ pavarā ca devatā. || ||
vv32:9.1: Patīsu dhammaṃ pacarāma sabbā patibbatā yattha bhavanti itthiyo patīsu dhammam pacaritva sabbā lacchāmase bhāsati yaṃ ayaṃ Latā. || ||
vv32:10.1: Sīho yathā pabbatasānugocaro mahiṃdharaṃ pabbatam āvasitvā pasayha hantvā itare catuppade khudde mige khādati maṃsabhojano, || ||
vv32:11.1: Tath' eva saddhā idha ariyasāvikā bhattāraṃ nissāya patiṃ anubbatā kodhaṃ vadhitvā abhibhuyya maccharaṃ saggamhi sā modati dhammacārinī ti. || ||
